verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֧ה וַ֠יָּשָׁב בְּשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ בֵּית֛וֹ לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yā·šāḇ bə·šā·lō·wm ’el- bê·ṯōw lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah had returned safely to his home in Jerusalem

verses.original: יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֘נִי֮ הַחֹזֶה֒ וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֶל־ פָּנָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט לַעְזֹ֔ר הֲלָרָשָׁ֣ע תֶּאֱהָ֑ב וּלְשֹׂנְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וּבָזֹאת֙ קֶּ֔צֶף יְהוָֽה׃ מִלִּפְנֵ֖י עָלֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: yê·hū ḇen- ḥă·nā·nî ha·ḥō·zeh way·yê·ṣê ’el- pā·nāw way·yō·mer ’el- ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ la‘·zōr hă·lā·rā·šā‘ te·’ĕ·hāḇ ū·lə·śō·nə·’ê Yah·weh ū·ḇā·zōṯ qe·ṣep̄ Yah·weh mil·lip̄·nê ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD Because of this the wrath of the LORD [is] vvv upon you

verses.original: אֲבָ֕ל דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִ֖ים נִמְצְא֣וּ עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ בִעַ֤רְתָּ הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַהֲכִינ֥וֹתָ לְבָבְךָ֖ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl də·ḇā·rîm ṭō·w·ḇîm nim·ṣə·’ū ‘im·māḵ kî- ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·’ă·šê·rō·wṯ min- hā·’ā·reṣ wa·hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯā lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā liḏ·rōš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: However some good is found in you for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑םס וַיָּ֜שָׁב וַיֵּצֵ֣א בָעָ֗ם מִבְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֙בַע֙ עַד־ הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיְשִׁיבֵ֕ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ way·yê·šeḇ bī·rū·šå̄·lå̄·ms way·yā·šāḇ way·yê·ṣê ḇā·‘ām mib·bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ‘aḏ- har ’ep̄·ra·yim way·šî·ḇêm ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem and once again he went out among the people vvv from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD the God of their fathers

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד שֹֽׁפְטִ֜ים בָּאָ֗רֶץ בְּכָל־ לְעִ֥יר וָעִֽיר׃ הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ šō·p̄ə·ṭîm bā·’ā·reṣ bə·ḵāl lə·‘îr wā·‘îr hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: He appointed judges in the land in each of the fortified cities of Judah

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ הַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה־ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כִּ֣י לֹ֧א תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ לְאָדָ֛ם כִּ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמָּכֶ֖ם בִּדְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- haš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm rə·’ū māh- ’at·tem ‘ō·śîm kî lō tiš·pə·ṭū lə·’ā·ḏām kî Yah·weh wə·‘im·mā·ḵem biḏ·ḇar miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Then he said to the judges Consider carefully what you do for you are not judging for man but for the LORD who is with you vvv when you render judgment

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה פַֽחַד־ יְהוָ֖ה יְהִ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ כִּֽי־ עִם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֵ֞ין עַוְלָ֛ה וּמַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּמִקַּח־ שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh p̄a·ḥaḏ- Yah·weh yə·hî ‘ă·lê·ḵem šim·rū wa·‘ă·śū kî- ‘im- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’ên ‘aw·lāh ū·maś·śō p̄ā·nîm ū·miq·qaḥ- šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: And now may the fear of the LORD be upon you Be careful what you do for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality . . . or bribery . . .

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט הֶעֱמִ֨יד בִּ֠ירוּשָׁלִַם מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּמֵרָאשֵׁ֤י לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָאָבוֹת֙ לְמִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְלָרִ֑יב וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ he·‘ĕ·mîḏ bî·rū·šā·lim min- hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ū·mê·rā·šê lə·yiś·rā·’êl hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·miš·paṭ Yah·weh wə·lā·rîḇ way·yā·šu·ḇū yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Moreover Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites priests and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes And they lived in Jerusalem

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּן֙ בֶּאֱמוּנָ֖ה שָׁלֵֽם׃ וּבְלֵבָ֥ב בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ‘ă·lê·hem lê·mōr kōh ṯa·‘ă·śūn be·’ĕ·mū·nāh šā·lêm ū·ḇə·lê·ḇāḇ bə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: He commanded them . . . saying . . . You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly . . . in the fear of the LORD

verses.original: וְכָל־ רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֣ם׀ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֗ם בֵּֽין־ דָּ֣ם׀ לְדָם֮ בֵּין־ תּוֹרָ֣ה לְמִצְוָה֮ לְחֻקִּ֣ים וּלְמִשְׁפָּטִים֒ וְהִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה קֶ֥צֶף וְהָֽיָה־ עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְעַל־ אֲחֵיכֶ֑ם תַעֲשׂ֖וּן כֹּ֥ה וְלֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl rîḇ ’ă·šer- yā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem mê·’ă·ḥê·ḵem hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘ā·rê·hem bên- dām lə·ḏām bên- tō·w·rāh lə·miṣ·wāh lə·ḥuq·qîm ū·lə·miš·pā·ṭîm wə·hiz·har·tem ’ō·ṯām wə·lō ye’·šə·mū Yah·weh qe·ṣep̄ wə·hā·yāh- ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·‘al- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem ṯa·‘ă·śūn kōh wə·lō ṯe’·šā·mū
verses.literal: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities whether [it regards] bloodshed or some other violation of law commandments statutes or ordinances you are to warn them - so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers Do this and you will not incur guilt

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ הָרֹ֨אשׁ כֹהֵן֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה וּזְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַנָּגִ֤יד לְבֵית־ יְהוּדָה֙ לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשׂ֔וּ חִזְק֣וּ יְהוָ֖ה וִיהִ֥י עִם־ הַטּֽוֹב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’ă·mar·yā·hū hā·rōš ḵō·hên ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·ḵōl də·ḇar- Yah·weh ū·zə·ḇaḏ·yā·hū ḇen- yiš·mā·‘êl han·nā·ḡîḏ lə·ḇêṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ḵōl də·ḇar- ham·me·leḵ hal·wî·yim wə·šō·ṭə·rîm lip̄·nê·ḵem wa·‘ă·śū ḥiz·qū Yah·weh wî·hî ‘im- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Note that Amariah the chief priest will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD and Zebadiah son of Ishmael the ruler of the house of Judah in all that pertains to the king And the Levites [will serve as] officers before you Act resolutely may the LORD be with the upright
